description: This Course provides a simple understanding of Refrigeration and Air-conditioning fundamentals. The course consists of different refrigeration cycles and understanding of psychrometry and psychrometric processes used for the purpose of air-conditioning. Further, the comfort air-conditioning.
experiments: To study the performance of vapour Compression refrigeration cycle
To study various components of room air conditioner.
To study three fluid vapour Absorption refrigeration system and find out its theoretical & actual COP.
To Study different refrigerant control and electric control devices of a refrigeration system.
Study and Performance of ice plant test rig.
To find the theoretical & experimental C.O.P. of the system, when using as refrigerator and as heat pump by reversing the cycle and show that (COP)HP = (COP)R + 1.
To Study the heat balance sheet on the computerised recirculating type air conditioning test rig.
To study humidification with heating & dehumidification with cooling.
To study the constructional details of hermetically sealed reciprocating compressor & rotary compressor.
To Study the performance of Solar-assisted heat pump
outcomes: Study of refrigerant compressors, expansion devices used in vapour compression refrigeration system, thermostat with range and differential setting, charging of refrigeration system.
Trial on pilot ice plant to evaluate cycle performance and actual coefficient of performance.
Participate in a group atmosphere for the understanding of an industrial refrigeration system.
Communicate effectively both verbally and in written form through the preparation of journal report and practical presentation.
